style: Style: bold screen-printed gig-poster illustration, risograph print texture with visible halftone dots and slight colour misregistration, thick confident black ink outlines, flat colour fields in a limited palette of rosa mexicano pink, marigold gold, rasta green, Caribbean turquoise, sunset orange and deep mezcal purple on warm cream paper, a Jamaican dancehall flyer crossed with a Mexican loteria card, joyful and lively, rich detail, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark.
sticker: Style: one single die-cut vinyl sticker, centred with generous empty space around it, thick black ink outline, then a wide clean white die-cut border around the whole shape, flat bold colours in rosa mexicano pink, marigold gold, rasta green, turquoise and sunset orange, subtle halftone shading, playful cartoon, isolated on a plain pure white background, no shadow, no text, no letters.

items.name: fiesta-panorama
items.prompt: A wide panoramic night scene on a Caribbean terrace restaurant in Punta Cana: a towering Jamaican sound system speaker stack on the left with a DJ selector, a karaoke singer with a microphone on a small stage, friends dancing and laughing under strings of warm bulbs and colourful papel picado bunting, palm trees silhouetted against a purple-to-orange sunset sky, a smoking jerk drum grill, tables with tacos, salt-rimmed margaritas and big cocktails, the sea and a full moon in the distance.

items.name: story-crossroads
items.prompt: Two cultures meeting at one table: on the left a Jamaican side with a rasta-coloured sound system, jerk chicken on a drum grill, ackee fruit, hibiscus flowers and palm leaves; on the right a Mexican side with marigold cempasuchil flowers, papel picado, tacos, limes, chili peppers and a mezcal bottle; in the middle two hands clinking cocktail glasses with a glowing heart between them and a sunburst behind.

items.name: karaoke
